screens.audience: Developers using AI coding agents daily
screens.purpose: Working surface for an open project: current round's files, agent states, and round cost

surfaces.name: status-bar
surfaces.output: Wordmark, working directory · round · provider · model in mono, nav with current item marked, version

surfaces.name: round-tree
surfaces.output: Mono heading .spec4/v{N}/, one full-width line per artifact in pipeline order coloured by lane (reference lane uncoloured), status at right only when 'needs update' or 'missing', three-item lane legend

surfaces.name: agent-rows
inputs: action button per row: Start (filled green), Continue (filled green, same as Start — shown instead of Start when the agent has an in-progress conversation), Required (filled green, same as Start), Modify (neutral outline, green text), Needs Update (warn outline), Not Ready (disabled outline). Activating a button routes to that agent exactly as the current agent-select buttons do
surfaces.output: Seven-row table: Agent · Produces · Last model · Tokens this round · action

surfaces.name: round-cost
surfaces.output: Three lines: estimated cost and tokens; unpriced calls named with models and excluded; dimmed price-source disclaimer

shared_layout.nav: Plain text links in the 40px status bar: Project, Settings, Docs; active item in accent green with 1px underline. Project is this screen. Settings opens the existing model/provider change flow and setup wizard. Docs is the one external link, to spec4.ai. No Artifacts link this round.
shell: main view up to 1100px wide, 16px padding, 8px rhythm
